pros: Sony WH-CH520 Wireless Bluetooth On-Ear Headphones - Black WH-CH520.

Enjoy stunning audio quality and long battery life on-the-go with the WH-CH520 Wireless Headphones from Sony, a pair of on-ear, closed-back headphones with powerful 30mm drivers for realistic sound reproduction.
These swiveling headphones sport a convenient microphone for making calls and support voice command control via Siri or Google Assistant.

Bluetooth 5.2 is on board for easy pairing with devices and supports a range of useful features such as Google Fast Pair, allowing you to find your missing headphones by sound, and multipoint connections for pairing to up to two devices.
cons: Not only is the design stylish, but it's also crafted with ease-of-use in mind.
compatibility: Bluetooth 5.2 is on board for easy pairing with devices and supports a range of useful features such as Google Fast Pair, allowing you to find your missing headphones by sound, and multipoint connections for pairing to up to two devices.

Compatibility with Sony's Headphones Connect app and 360 Reality Audio technology allow you to enjoy an incredibly immersive and highly personalized listening experience that suits your individual tastes and ear shape.
The onboard battery lasts up to 50 hours with a three-hour charge time, and you can get 1.5 hours of use out of only a 3-minute fast charge via the included USB-C charging cable.
And, if your headphones battery is running low, a 3-minute quick-charge with the included USB-C cable can give you 1.5 hours of listening time.
